```{r}
aaa <- c(
  "data_manually_modified/CFT_wo_AB.csv",
  "data_manually_modified/NILS69_wo_AB.csv",
  "data_manually_modified/PAS_wo_AB.csv",
  "data_manually_modified/UTI_wo_AB.csv",
  "data_manually_modified/CFT_w_AB.csv",
  "data_manually_modified/NILS69_w_AB.csv",
  "data_manually_modified/PAS_w_AB.csv",
  "data_manually_modified/UTI_w_AB.csv"
) %>% 
  lapply(read.csv)

DF_ALL_DATA <- lapply(
  aaa, 
  function (x) dplyr::mutate(
    x, 
    CFU_mL=as.numeric(CFU_mL),
    log10_CFU_gr=as.numeric(log10_CFU_gr)
    )
  ) %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(strain = factor(strain, levels = v_strain_levels))

# DF_ALL_DATA
```




```{r}
df_LacZ_fraction_ALL <- DF_ALL_DATA %>% 
  dplyr::select(group, id, organ, DAY, AB_code, strain, LacZ_p_CFU_mL, LacZ_m_CFU_mL) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(LacZ_fraction=LacZ_p_CFU_mL/(LacZ_p_CFU_mL + LacZ_m_CFU_mL))

# df_LacZ_fraction_ALL %>% head()
```



```{r}
df_4_mnlx_tmp <- DF_ALL_DATA %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(
    df_LacZ_fraction_ALL %>% dplyr::select(id, organ, DAY, AB_code, strain, LacZ_fraction),
    by=c("id", "organ", "DAY", "AB_code", "strain")
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    OBSERVATION=case_when(
      organ == "K" ~ CFU_gr,
      organ == "B" ~ CFU_gr,
      organ == "U" ~ 10^(log10_CFU_mL)
    ),
    OBSERVATION_UNITS=case_when(
      organ == "K" ~ "CFU/g",
      organ == "B" ~ "CFU/g",
      organ == "U" ~ "CFU/ml"
    ),
    OBSERVATION_LOG10=case_when(
      organ == "K" ~ log10(CFU_gr),
      organ == "B" ~ log10(CFU_gr),
      organ == "U" ~ log10_CFU_mL
    )
  ) %>% dplyr::select(
  group, organ, id, organ_weight, DAY, AB_code, strain, LacZ_fraction, OBSERVATION, OBSERVATION_UNITS, OBSERVATION_LOG10
) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(
    # "OBSID" = "organ",
    "grupo" = "group",
    "TIME" = "DAY"
  )

```




## Generalities {.tabset}
Assumptions:
 - 

### Protocol Description

We estimate the weight at 20g as all the mice are 8 week-old 

 - 8 week-old Mice were infected on Monday (D0)
 - Antibiotic treatment is started on Wednesday morning (D2 post-infection).
 - For cefotaxime: 100 mg/kg every 6 hours for 24 hours
 - For fosfomycin: 100 mg/kg every 4 hours for 24 hours
 - For ciprofloxacin: dose of 2.5 or 10 mg/kg at 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. for 48 hours
 - For delafloxacin: dose of 10 mg/kg at 9 a.m. and 17 p.m. for 48 hours
 - Sacrifice takes place on Friday morning (D4 post infection)



### Bacteria Strains
Mice are infected with the following bacteria strains:

 - PAS:
 - UTI:
 - CFT:
 - NILS69:

### Number of Mice

```{r}

df_mice_group_distribution <- df_4_mnlx_tmp %>% 
  dplyr::select(strain, AB_code, id, TIME) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(AB_code = factor(AB_code, levels = v_AB_code_levels)) %>% 
  group_by(strain, AB_code, TIME) %>% 
  summarise(Num=n()) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(strain, AB_code, TIME) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = TIME, values_from = Num) %>% 
  
  dplyr::arrange(strain, AB_code) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() 

df_mice_group_distribution %>% 
  mutate(RowSum = rowSums(dplyr::select(., -strain, -AB_code), na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(., dplyr::summarise(., across(`1`:RowSum, .fns = function (x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)  ))) %>% 

# df_mice_group_distribution %>% 
  flextable::flextable() %>% 
  flextable::merge_v(j=c("strain")) %>% 
  flextable::theme_zebra()
```




## Organ weight {.tabset}




### Control Group
Control group is a group with infection but without AB treatment.

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
df_Ct_weight <- df_4_mnlx_tmp %>% 
  dplyr::select(organ, id, TIME, strain, AB_code, organ_weight) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(organ=factor(organ, levels = v_organ_levels)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(organ != "U") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(AB_code == "Ct") 

df_Ct_weight_Stats <- df_Ct_weight %>% 
  group_by(organ, TIME, strain, AB_code) %>% 
  nest() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    Stats = map_df(data, ~ceor_stats(.$organ_weight, na.rm = TRUE) )
  ) %>%
  unnest(Stats) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-data)

lbl_y <- "weight (g)"
lbl_x <- "time (days)"
lbl_subtitle <- "Ct"
df_Ct_weight %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=TIME, y=organ_weight, color=strain, shape=strain)) +
  geom_point(size=2) +
  # geom_jitter(size=2) +
  geom_line(data=df_Ct_weight_Stats, aes(y=q50), size=1) +
  geom_errorbar(data=df_Ct_weight_Stats, aes(ymin=q50, ymax=q50, y=q50), size=1) +
  facet_wrap(~organ, scales = "free") +
  theme_ano +
  labs(x=lbl_x, y=lbl_y, subtitle = lbl_subtitle) +
  scale_color_manual(values = nv_strain_color) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = nv_strain_shape)
  # pull(AB_code) %>% unique()
```


```{r}

lbl_y <- "K weight (g)"
lbl_x <- "B weight (g)"
lbl_subtitle <- "Ct"

df_Ct_weight_Stats %>%
```

```{r}
  group_by(organ, OBSERVATION_UNITS, TIME, AB_code, strain) %>%
```

#### AB Ct, Days 2, 10, 16

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
v_TIME_TMP <- c(2, 10, 16)
str_AB_code_TMP <- "Ct"
lbl_subtitle <- sprintf("Organ: %s, AB: %s, Day: %s", str_ORGAN_TMP, str_AB_code_TMP, paste(v_TIME_TMP, collapse = ", ") )
lbl_y <- "log(CFU/g)"

df_Stats_log10_CFU_Units_TMP <- df_Stats_log10_CFU_Units %>% 
  dplyr::filter(AB_code == str_AB_code_TMP) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(TIME %in% v_TIME_TMP) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(TIME = as.factor(TIME)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(organ == str_ORGAN_TMP)

df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP <- df_4_mnlx_tmp %>% 
  dplyr::filter(AB_code == str_AB_code_TMP) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(TIME %in% v_TIME_TMP) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(TIME = as.factor(TIME)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(organ == str_ORGAN_TMP)


get_wilcox_pvalue <- function(str_strain_1, str_strain_2, df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP){
  b_strain_1 <- df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP %>% dplyr::filter(strain == str_strain_1) %>% nrow() > 0 
  b_strain_2 <- df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP %>% dplyr::filter(strain == str_strain_2) %>% nrow() > 0 
  if ( b_strain_1 & b_strain_2 ){
    p.value <- wilcox.test(
      df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP %>% dplyr::filter(strain == str_strain_1) %>% pull(OBSERVATION),
      df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP %>% dplyr::filter(strain == str_strain_2) %>% pull(OBSERVATION), 
      correct = FALSE
    )$p.value
  }else{
    p.value <- NA
  }
  return(p.value)
}
```

### {-}

## {-}

## Bacteria CFU K + B {.tabset}

\begin{equation}
  W = w_{K}K + w_{B}B
\end{equation}
where $w_{K}$ and  $w_{B}$ are the corresponding weights(g) of Kidney and Bladder.



```{r}
# What should I do with the LacZ_fraction here?

df_4_mnlx_W <- bind_rows(
  df_4_mnlx_tmp %>% dplyr::filter(organ != "U") %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(grupo, id, TIME, AB_code, strain) %>% 
    summarise(OBSERVATION=sum(organ_weight*OBSERVATION)) %>% 
    dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(organ="W") %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(OBSERVATION_UNITS = "CFU") %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(OBSERVATION_LOG10 = log10(OBSERVATION)),
  df_4_mnlx_tmp %>% dplyr::filter(organ == "U")
) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(strain, AB_code, id, TIME)

# df_4_mnlx_W
  
```

<!-- fK = a/(a+b) -->
<!-- fB = c/(c+d) -->

<!-- fW = (a+c)/(a+b+c+d) -->




```{r}
df_Stats_log10_W_U_CFU_Units <- df_4_mnlx_W %>% 
  group_by(organ, OBSERVATION_UNITS, TIME, AB_code, strain) %>% 
  nest() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    Stats = map_df(data, ~ceor_stats(.$OBSERVATION_LOG10, na.rm = TRUE) )
  ) %>%
  unnest(Stats) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-data) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(AB_code=factor(AB_code, levels = v_AB_code_levels)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(strain=factor(strain, levels = v_strain_levels)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(organ=factor(organ, levels = v_organ_levels))
```

```{r}
str_ORGAN_TMP <- "K"
lbl_caption <- "Kidney LacZ+ fraction"

df_Stats_LacZ_p %>%
  dplyr::filter(organ == str_ORGAN_TMP) %>% 
  dplyr::select(strain, AB_code, organ, TIME, everything(), -organ, -OBSERVATION_UNITS) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(AB_code=factor(AB_code, levels = v_AB_code_levels)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(num=as.integer(num)) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(strain, AB_code, TIME) %>% 
  flextable::flextable() %>% 
  flextable::theme_zebra() %>% 
  flextable::merge_v(j=c("strain", "AB_code", "organ")) %>% 
  flextable::colformat_double(digits = 2, na_str = "N/A") %>% 
  flextable::set_caption(lbl_caption)

```


### Bladder
```{r}
str_ORGAN_TMP <- "B"
lbl_caption <- "Bladder LacZ+ fraction"

df_Stats_LacZ_p %>%
  dplyr::filter(organ == str_ORGAN_TMP) %>% 
  dplyr::select(strain, AB_code, organ, TIME, everything(), -organ, -OBSERVATION_UNITS) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(AB_code=factor(AB_code, levels = v_AB_code_levels)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(num=as.integer(num)) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(strain, AB_code, TIME) %>% 
  flextable::flextable() %>% 
  flextable::theme_zebra() %>% 
  flextable::merge_v(j=c("strain", "AB_code", "organ")) %>% 
  flextable::colformat_double(digits = 2, na_str = "N/A") %>% 
  flextable::set_caption(lbl_caption)

```


# Notes
 - Looks like for Cirpo_d010 group the Kidney weight is always high in comparision with Ct group at day 1 at least
 - Appart from some outliers Bladder weight is more uniform.
 - The amounts W for Ct group are higher that the others with AB, which makes sense, however why is reduced at day 1 if Antibiotic treatment is started on D2 post-infection. Something may be weird, probably an annotation problem in data. 
 - For NIELS69 we only have 2 days in the Ct group.
 

 - LacZ+ fraction in bladder drops pretty fast compare with Kidney and Urine.
